Dependent field fixture

Every case here is a page that answers back. Written against UC-034 and DD-009: each <fieldset> is one alternative flow, and the harness in scripts/e2e-cascade.mjs names the case it belongs to.

No radios and no checkboxes anywhere in this file — deliberately. The overcount check in the harness compares the reported filled count against the controls that actually hold a value, and a radio group reports one outcome per member while holding one value between them. Toggles would make the arithmetic a judgement call rather than an assertion.

c1 — native cascade
c2 — chained cascade
c3 — debounced cascade (350 ms)
c4 — fields revealed by an earlier answer
c5 — control enabled by an earlier answer
c6 — value wiped by a property assignment, once
c7 — page reverts every write
c8 — control replaced after being filled
c9 — page normalises what we write
c10 — ARIA combobox with a portaled listbox
